overview: The Committee of the Whole held its sixth preliminary budget meeting for Fiscal Year 2027, reviewing proposals for the Elections, Legislative, Fire, and Library departments. The committee discussed staffing shortages, wage equity for part-time employees, and the implementation of positions required by the city charter.

items.title: Elections Department Budget
items.summary: Elections Manager James Blatchford presented a budget increase for overtime to cover three upcoming elections and discussed goals for automating the city census and emergency planning.

items.title: Legislative Budget
items.summary: Councilors debated an administration-proposed 12% cut to the legislative budget and the failure to fund a charter-mandated City Messenger/Legislative Aide position. The discussion included disagreements over budgetary actuals and the legality of cost-of-living raises for elected officials under the new charter.

items.title: Fire Department Budget
items.summary: Chief Todd Evans detailed critical staffing shortages, high run volumes for Engines 1 and 4, and the impact of injuries on overtime costs. Approved a motion to request a breakdown of the professional services line item, specifically regarding litigation and arbitration costs.

items.title: Library Budget
items.summary: Director Sam Sednick requested a $4 per hour raise for part-time staff to address significant pay disparities and identified errors in the personnel count within the administration's budget document. Approved a motion to request an updated budget featuring accurate personnel data and the requested wage increases.
